{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "qPCR_setup", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Define the master mix liquid
    protocol.define_liquid("mix", "Master mix for qPCR", "#FF0000")
    
    # Load the source plate (samples)
    source_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 2)
    
    # Define and load each sample as its own liquid
    for row in "ABCDEFGH":
        for col in range(1, 13):
            well_name = row + str(col)
            source_liquid_name = f"source_{well_name}"
            protocol.define_liquid(source_liquid_name, f"Sample from {well_name}", "#00FF00")
            # Load 100 ul of each sample into its well
            source_plate[well_name].load_liquid(liquid=source_liquid_name, volume=100)
    
    # Load reservoir for master mix
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 3)
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid="mix", volume=1600)
    
    # Load tip rack and p20 pipette
    tips = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 4)
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[tips])
    
    # Load the qPCR plate (destination)
    pcr_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt", 1)
    
    # Transfer 15 ul mix + 5 ul template to each well
    for row in "ABCDEFGH":
        for col in range(1, 13):
            dest_well = row + str(col)
            p20.pick_up_tip()
            # Aspirate 15 ul of master mix
            p20.aspirate(15, reservoir["A1"])
            # Dispense 15 ul mix into destination well
            p20.dispense(15, pcr_plate[dest_well])
            # Aspirate 5 ul from the matching source well
            p20.aspirate(5, source_plate[dest_well])
            # Dispense 5 ul template into the same well
            p20.dispense(5, pcr_plate[dest_well])
            p20.drop_tip()"}

{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "qPCR_setup", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Define the master mix liquid
    master_mix = protocol.define_liquid("mix", "Master mix for qPCR", "#FF0000")
    
    # Define water for no‑template control
    water = protocol.define_liquid("water", "Water for no‑template control", "#00FFFF")
    
    # Load the source plate (samples)
    source_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 2)
    
    # Define and load each sample as its own liquid
    for row in "ABCDEFGH":
        for col in range(1, 13):
            well_name = row + str(col)
            source_liquid_name = f"source_{well_name}"
            # Define the liquid and keep the object
            src_liquid_obj = protocol.define_liquid(source_liquid_name, f"Sample from {well_name}", "#00FF00")
            # Load 100 µL of each sample into its well
            source_plate[well_name].load_liquid(liquid=src_liquid_obj, volume=100)
    
    # Load water into a dedicated well for the no‑template control
    water_reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 5)
    water_reservoir["B1"].load_liquid(liquid=water, volume=100)
    
    # Load reservoir for master mix (enough volume to stay above tip)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 3)
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=master_mix, volume=1700)  # ~1700 µL keeps tip submerged
    
    # Load tip rack and p20 pipette
    tips = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 4)
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[tips])
    
    # Load the qPCR plate (destination)
    pcr_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt", 1)
    
    # Designate a no‑template control well (e.g., A12)
    no_template_well = "A12"
    
    # Transfer 15 µL mix + 5 µL template (or water) to each well
    for row in "ABCDEFGH":
        for col in range(1, 13):
            dest_well = row + str(col)
            p20.pick_up_tip()
            if dest_well == no_template_well:
                # No‑template control: aspirate 5 µL water, dispense into well
                p20.aspirate(5, water_reservoir["B1"])
                p20.dispense(5, pcr_plate[dest_well])
                # Aspirate 15 µL master mix
                p20.aspirate(15, reservoir["A1"])
                # Dispense 15 µL mix into well
                p20.dispense(15, pcr_plate[dest_well])
                # Mix the well (≈80 % of well volume)
                p20.mix(5, 16, pcr_plate[dest_well])
            else:
                # Regular well: aspirate 5 µL template, dispense into well
                p20.aspirate(5, source_plate[dest_well])
                p20.dispense(5, pcr_plate[dest_well])
                # Aspirate 15 µL master mix
                p20.aspirate(15, reservoir["A1"])
                # Dispense 15 µL mix into well
                p20.dispense(15, pcr_plate[dest_well])
                # Mix the well (≈80 % of well volume)
                p20.mix(5, 16, pcr_plate[dest_well])
            p20.drop_tip()"}

tool_calls.arguments:
{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "qPCR_setup", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Define the master mix liquid
    master_mix = protocol.define_liquid("mix", "Master mix for qPCR", "#FF0000")
    
    # Define water for no-template control
    water = protocol.define_liquid("water", "Water for no-template control", "#00FFFF")
    
    # Load the source plate (samples)
    source_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 2)
    
    # Define and load each sample as its own liquid
    for row in "ABCDEFGH":
        for col in range(1, 13):
            well_name = row + str(col)
            source_liquid_name = f"source_{well_name}"
            # Define the liquid and keep the object
            src_liquid_obj = protocol.define_liquid(source_liquid_name, f"Sample from {well_name}", "#00FF00")
            # Load 100 ul of each sample into its well
            source_plate[well_name].load_liquid(liquid=src_liquid_obj, volume=100)
    
    # Load water into a dedicated well for the no-template control
    water_reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 5)
    water_reservoir["A2"].load_liquid(liquid=water, volume=100)
    
    # Load reservoir for master mix (enough volume to stay above tip)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 3)
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=master_mix, volume=1700)  # ~1700 ul keeps tip submerged
    
    # Load tip rack and p20 pipette
    tips = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 4)
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[tips])
    
    # Load the qPCR plate (destination)
    pcr_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt", 1)
    
    # Designate a no-template control well (e.g., A12)
    no_template_well = "A12"
    
    # Transfer 15 ul mix + 5 ul template (or water) to each well
    for row in "ABCDEFGH":
        for col in range(1, 13):
            dest_well = row + str(col)
            p20.pick_up_tip()
            if dest_well == no_template_well:
                # No-template control: aspirate 5 ul water, dispense into well
                p20.aspirate(5, water_reservoir["A2"])
                p20.dispense(5, pcr_plate[dest_well])
                # Aspirate 15 ul master mix
                p20.aspirate(15, reservoir["A1"])
                # Dispense 15 ul mix into well
                p20.dispense(15, pcr_plate[dest_well])
                # Mix the well (≈80% of well volume)
                p20.mix(5, 16, pcr_plate[dest_well])
            else:
                # Regular well: aspirate 5 ul template, dispense into well
                p20.aspirate(5, source_plate[dest_well])
                p20.dispense(5, pcr_plate[dest_well])
                # Aspirate 15 ul master mix
                p20.aspirate(15, reservoir["A1"])
                # Dispense 15 ul mix into well
                p20.dispense(15, pcr_plate[dest_well])
                # Mix the well (≈80% of well volume)
                p20.mix(5, 16, pcr_plate[dest_well])
            p20.drop_tip()"}

protocol.py: 3 biology problems (2 errors, 1 note).

1. ERROR SOURCE-TOO-SHALLOW: The pipette draws air from well A2 in slot 5: the liquid is
below the tip
   line 50:  p20.aspirate(5, water_reservoir["A2"])
   At line 50 the p20_single_gen2 draws 5 ul from water (well A2 in slot 5) with its tip 1
   mm above the bottom of the well. By then the well holds 100 ul, which in this NEST 12
   Well Reservoir 15 mL reaches only 0.55 mm up: the tip is above the liquid and draws air.
   The simulator does not notice: it does not follow the liquid. The 1 well filled from
   these draws got air instead of liquid.
   Affected: well A2 in slot 5.
   Also reached 1 other well: well A12 in slot 1.
   Fix: Keep the liquid above the tip. This well needs about 258 ul in it for the surface to
   reach 1 mm. Load that much more than the run draws; or draw from a smaller vessel (a tube
   lifts the liquid); or aspirate lower with `well.bottom(0.5)`.
   Source: Opentrons: liquid control (aspirates 1 mm above the bottom of the well by
   default)
           https://docs.opentrons.com/v2/basic_commands/liquids.html
   Source: Artel: automated liquid handlers as sources of error
           https://www.bioprocessintl.com/assays/automated-liquid-handlers-as-sources-of-error
   Source: Gilson guide to pipetting (immersion depth 2 to 3 mm for 1 to 100 ul)
           https://solutions.pipette.com/wp-content/uploads/Gilson-Guide-to-Pipetting.pdf
   Source: labautomation.io 7592: negative controls positive after aspirating air
           https://labautomation.io/t/aspiration-dispense-liquid-class-incompatibity/7592
   Source: Integra: 260 ul dead volume in a standard reservoir
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applications/minimizing-dead-volume-during-qpcr-set-divided-reservoir-assist-plus-pipetting-robot
   [e434524387cb]

2. ERROR CONTAM-STOCK: A used tip went into a stock: mix (well A1 in slot 3)
   line 63:  p20.aspirate(15, reservoir["A1"])
   At line 63 the tip went into mix (well A1 in slot 3) while it still carried source_A1
   (well A1 in slot 2), source_A2 (well A2 in slot 2), source_A3 (well A3 in slot 2),
   source_A4 (well A4 in slot 2) and 91 more from an earlier step (this line did it 95
   times). A tip that has touched one liquid leaves a little of it in the next liquid it
   touches, so this stock now holds material that does not belong there. Liquid drawn from
   it then took the unwanted material along into 95 other wells: wells A2, A3, A4, A5, A6,
   A7, A8, A9 and 87 more in slot 1.
   Affected: well A1 in slot 3.
   Also reached 95 other wells: wells A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, A9 and 87 more in slot 1.
   Fix: Pick up a fresh tip before line 63 goes into the stock. Or change the order: hand
   out the shared liquid first, while the tip is still clean, and add the other liquids
   afterwards with a fresh tip each.
   Source: Lab Manager: minimizing cross-contamination in automated liquid handling
           https://www.labmanager.com/minimizing-cross-contamination-in-automated-liquid-handling-workflows-35194
   Source: WHO: dos and don'ts for molecular testing
           https://www.who.int/teams/global-malaria-programme/case-management/diagnosis/nucleic-acid-amplification-based-diagnostics/dos-and-don-ts-for-molecular-testing
   [df1baffda96b]

3. NOTE NO-SAMPLE-INTO-REAGENT-WELL: (proposed) A tip that had been in a sample went into a
reagent
   line 63:  p20.aspirate(15, reservoir["A1"])
   At line 63 the tip touched the liquid in well A1 in slot 3 while it still carried
   source_A1 (well A1 in slot 2), source_A2 (well A2 in slot 2), source_A3 (well A3 in slot
